revenue_scope: North America segment: Teva's COPAXONE row in the table of revenues by major products and activities
why_separate: From 2018 Teva prints COPAXONE only inside its geographic segment tables, one row per segment (North America, Europe, International Markets), and no worldwide row; the North America row is one piece of the worldwide line the series recorded, so it is a narrower line and is not spliced.
notes: Covers 2018Q1-2023Q4. The Europe and International Markets rows (Q1 2018: 153 and 16) are separate rows of the same kind and are not summed here. Check on the shares Teva states in text: Europe 153 of 476+153+16 is 23.7%, stated 24% for Q1 2018; Europe 124 of 463+124+14 is 20.6%, stated 21% for Q3 2018, so the three rows are consistent with the stated global total. From 2024 Teva reports Canada in International Markets and renames the segment United States (see teva_copaxone_cont_us); 2023 on that basis is 71, 56, 98 and 72 (prior-year columns of the 2024 releases, not scored). Annual checks against the 10-K segment rows: 2018 476+464+463+356=1,759 (1,759); 2019 208+274+271+264=1,017 (1,017); 2020 198+238+236+213=885 (884, rounding); 2021 164+152+133+129=578 (577, rounding); 2022 86+94+105+101=386 (387, rounding); 2023 76+64+103+78=321 (320, rounding).
search_log: Listed every Teva filing from data.sec.gov submissions (CIK 818686, recent file and the 1996-2017 history file) filed 2016-04-01 to 2026-09-01. Fetched every htm document of every 10-Q, 10-K, 10-K/A, 20-F, 20-F/A, 8-K/A, 6-K and 6-K/A, and of every 8-K that carries item 2.02 (929 documents). 8-Ks without item 2.02 were not opened, so an absence below holds only for the documents read. Exhibits 3x/21/23/10 and XBRL R files were skipped.

Extracted every table row whose first cell names the product (and, for Treanda, BENDEKA) from those documents and read the heading above each table for the segment it belongs to; each quarter was taken from that quarter's own earnings release (8-K Exhibit 99.1, or the 6-K body/exhibit in 2016-2017), where the quarter is the current-period column.
Partners and royalty holders (for the bendamustine products, Eagle Pharmaceuticals) were not searched: that licence is for royalties on Bendeka and no Eagle document was read.

Global COPAXONE revenue is not printed in dollars after 2017Q4: the 10-Q and 10-K text gives only shares ('Revenues of COPAXONE in our Europe segment were 24% of global COPAXONE revenues in the first quarter of 2018'; 'COPAXONE global sales accounted for approximately 13% of our global revenues'). Sum of the three segment rows is not recorded as a row because the verifier needs every quoted figure on one printed line.
Segment attribution: in every release the first COPAXONE row sits under 'Three months ended' in the North America segment table; the Europe and International Markets tables follow in that order.
